Theorem
[Lax--Milgram--Lions theorem (Theorem K.1)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0348 1. appk:K.1\group Implicit Function Theorem

Let $A$ be a Hilbert space, $B$ a normed linear space, and $f:A\times B\to \mathbb R$ a continuous bilinear form. The following are equivalent:

  1. there is $c>0$ with

    \[ \inf _{\| b\| =1}\sup _{\| a\| \le 1}|f(a,b)|\ge c; \]

  2. for every $L\in B^*$ there is $a_L\in A$ such that $f(a_L,b)=L(b)$ for all $b\in B$.

When $A=B$, the condition $f(a,a)\ge c\| a\| _A^2$ implies coercivity.
